name: manage_skill
description: List, inspect and activate skills, read bundled resources, and run declared script helpers through their sandbox. To download or import skills, first use inspect_install_sources with local paths, public GitHub repository/skill URLs, or direct .zip/.skill/Markdown URLs. It returns skillFile/contentDigest selections and package warnings without installing. Then use install_sources with the chosen selections and the same sources/github_ref; installation verifies the inspected content, persists complete resource bundles and returns active skill IDs. GitHub SKILL.md URLs include sibling resources. Private repositories require an authenticated local checkout. Installation does not execute scripts. When an available skill matches the user task, call activate_skill before following its workflow. Use view_skill for inspection, list_skills to discover installed skills, and view_resource for referenced files. Use run_resource_helper only when an activated skill explicitly instructs it. Use proposals for self-evolution; applying proposals, installing skills and executing helpers follow the host approval policy.

action.description: Skill inspection, activation, resource loading/helper execution, or evolution action to perform.

proposal_id.description: Proposal id for view_proposal, apply_proposal, or reject_proposal.

sources.description: Required for inspect_install_sources and install_sources. Local Markdown/archive/directory paths in the current file scope, or public HTTP(S) skill URLs. Multiple sources and collections are supported.

selection.description: Required for install_sources. Copy the exact chosen skillFile and contentDigest values from inspection; unselected skills are not installed.

github_ref.description: Optional exact branch/tag/commit for GitHub sources. Required to disambiguate a branch containing '/'. Use the same value in inspection and installation. Repository root URLs default to HEAD.

replace_existing.description: For install_sources only. Defaults to false. Set true only when updating the inspected same-name user skills is intended; built-in names remain protected.

accept_blocked_warnings.description: For install_sources only. Defaults to false. Explicitly acknowledge blocked warnings from the selected packages; follow host approval requirements.

skill_id.description: Skill id for view_skill, activate_skill, view_resource, run_resource_helper, or existing user skill id for propose_patch. Built-in skill ids are read-only for patching.

resource_path.description: Bundled resource path for view_resource or run_resource_helper, for example references/playbook.md or scripts/helper.py. run_resource_helper only supports script resources ending in .py, .js, .mjs, or .cjs.

helper_args.description: Arguments passed to the skill resource helper script after the script path when action is run_resource_helper.

stdin.description: Optional stdin payload for run_resource_helper. Use this for large input instead of stuffing it into helper_args.

timeout_secs.description: Optional run_resource_helper timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.

name.description: Skill name for propose_create, or replacement name for propose_patch.

description.description: Concise trigger description for the proposed skill.

content.description: Full proposed skill body. Keep it procedural, specific, and reusable. Large valid SKILL.md bodies are accepted; use resource_bundle for scripts, references, and assets instead of flattening them into this field.

resource_bundle.description: Optional complete resource bundle for propose_create or propose_patch. Paths must be relative and normally begin with scripts/, references/, assets/, or agents/.

rationale.description: Why this skill change is warranted, grounded in observed repeated behavior or user feedback.

status.description: Optional proposal status filter for list_proposals.

limit.description: Maximum skills or proposals to return for list_skills or list_proposals.
